data.name: Shivakant
data.gender_notes: Shivakant is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Shivakant is derived from the Hindu deity Lord Shiva, who is the god of destruction and regeneration. The name Shivakant is believed to bring power, strength, and protection. The name Shivakant carries the meaning “God Shiva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shivakant usually hope their child will grow to embody god shiva and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Shivakant is a spiritual name that invokes the blessings of Lord Shiva, who is the embodiment of divine power, destruction, and regeneration. It is a name that is believed to bring strength, courage, and protection to the bearer.
data.etymology: Shivakant belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God Shiva.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shivakant total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
